content.overview: Section 20 prescribes statutory modes for serving documents on a company or officer and, separately, on the Registrar or a member. It recognises physical and prescribed electronic modes and defines courier by reference to proof of delivery.
content.glance: Service on a company/officer can use the registered office, specified postal/courier methods, physical delivery or prescribed electronic modes; service on the Registrar/member follows a separate rule.
content.study: Section 20 provides a statutory framework for service of documents. Under sub-section (1), a document may be served on a company or officer at the registered office by registered post, speed post, courier, by leaving it at the registered office, or by prescribed electronic or other modes. Where securities are held with a depository, beneficial-ownership records may be served by the depository on the company electronically or by another prescribed mode. Under sub-section (2), subject to the Act/rules concerning electronic filing with the Registrar, documents may be served on the Registrar or a member by post, registered post, speed post, courier, delivery at the office/address, or prescribed electronic/other modes. A member may request a particular mode on payment of fees determined by the company in general meeting. The Explanation defines courier as a person or agency that delivers the document and provides proof of delivery.

sections.heading: Service on company or officer
sections.body: The permitted statutory modes include registered post, speed post, courier, leaving the document at the registered office, and prescribed electronic or other modes.

sections.heading: Depository records
sections.body: Where securities are held with a depository, records of beneficial ownership may be served by the depository on the company by electronic or other prescribed mode.

sections.heading: Service on Registrar or member
sections.body: Subject to the Act/rules concerning electronic filing with the Registrar, service may be by post, registered post, speed post, courier, delivery at office/address, or prescribed electronic/other mode.

sections.heading: Member's requested mode
sections.body: A member may request delivery through a particular mode and must pay the fees determined by the company in its general meeting.

sections.heading: Courier and proof of delivery
sections.body: The Explanation requires a courier for this section to be a person or agency that delivers the document and provides proof of delivery.
